context_purpose: Prevent a child from being released to someone the custodial guardian has not approved.

norm_violation_today.reason: A sign-out sheet listing the delegate's ID, phone and custody situation is readable by other parents and staff who have no need to see it.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A guardian-signed token cannot show the guardian is the legally custodial one, and cannot let staff verify that the person standing there is the delegate; a court-ordered restriction or an in-person identity check is not covered.

transmission_check.reason: Child safety is a business practice, not a known statutory demand for ID copies, so a stricter-than-sheet authorisation should be acceptable, though I am not certain of Taiwanese buxiban rules.

context_purpose: Make sure alcohol is only sold to people over the legal drinking age.

norm_violation_today.reason: Photocopying passport or ARC with nationality and document number to unlock a vending machine collects far more than an age check requires.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing for the sale itself, but the hotel loses a copy for registration, which it collects separately anyway.

transmission_check.reason: Hotel guest registration is plausibly a legal duty, but the vending age check is a separate step whose copy requirement I cannot confirm; it is largely a variant of the age-gated purchase.

context_purpose: Confirm that each voter is an eligible party member in the district and votes only once in the primary.

norm_violation_today.reason: Photocopying ID cards and recording address at a polling table creates a retained record of members' political affiliation beyond what eligibility and double-vote checks need.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little: the committee cannot resolve disputes about a specific named person's vote without the issuer, which is acceptable for a secret ballot.

transmission_check.reason: Party primaries are internal governance and, as far as I know, no statute requires copying the ID card, but I cannot confirm party or election-commission rules.

context_purpose: Release only each heir's rightful share of a deceased depositor's account and protect the bank from claims by a missed heir.

norm_violation_today.reason: The bank settling an estate is entitled to the full heir record, and spreading it to branches is an internal handling issue rather than a flow violation.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The bank cannot verify completeness of the heir roster, disclaimers, or contested claims from a one-sided share threshold, which is the very thing protecting it from liability.

transmission_check.reason: Banks generally need an inheritance record from all heirs (and sometimes a court document) to release estate funds, so a per-heir threshold would not satisfy this.

context_purpose: Ensure the renter is lawfully in Taiwan for the whole rental period and can be traced if the scooter is not returned.

norm_violation_today.reason: Keeping full passport scans in a phone or LINE chat holds much more than a stay-validity fact and exposes it to loose handling.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The shop also wants a way to find a tourist who absconds with the scooter, and a driving licence check, which an expiry predicate does not provide.

transmission_check.reason: Passport copy is mostly shop practice and insurer demand; I cannot confirm any rental statute demanding it, and a licence record is probably still required.

context_purpose: Protect newborns and mothers by letting only authorised visitors onto the ward.

norm_violation_today.reason: Asking for marital status, household registration and a partner address to check relationship exceeds what a named-visitor door check needs and retains it in a log.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The door needs to bind the pass to the physical visitor and keep an audit trail for infant-abduction incidents, which unlinkable passes weaken.

transmission_check.reason: Infant security policy is hospital-set and a named-list pass probably suffices, but liability logging rules for hospitals are unknown to me.

context_purpose: Confirm each voter owns a unit and holds one ballot, and compute quorum by ownership share for the owners' meeting.

norm_violation_today.reason: A full transcript and ID copy reveal mortgages, liens and ID numbers to volunteer committee members when only unit and share are needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little, though audit of a disputed quorum needs a retained record of unit, share and ballot, which the pseudonym scheme can supply.

transmission_check.reason: The management statute and building bylaws require records of the meeting and quorum, but I cannot confirm that they demand copies of the transcript.

context_purpose: Lend valuable items only to members with good standing in the co-ops.

norm_violation_today.reason: Circulating a member's name and past conduct in group chats shares a negative reputation with parties who have no relation to this loan.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little: a good-standing check is all the steward needs, though stewards lose context about past incidents they may weigh in person.

transmission_check.reason: Volunteer co-ops have no legal duty to collect ID photos or share lists, so a lighter proof is allowed.
